message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 113, "amount_cents": 7379}, {"order_id": 115, "amount_cents": 6651}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Start by listing the orders and refunds so I can verify the refunds table matches what Alpha reported before paying anyone.
The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly (orders 113 and 115, same amounts), so I can proceed. Next I need the orders to find which customers to pay.
The refunds table matches Alpha's report, and the orders show three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. Next I'll get acme's net balance.
Acme's net balance of 22142 matches orders 110 and 113 (10805 + 18716 = 29521) minus refund 113 (7379). Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net of 49030 matches orders 111 and 114 (39303 + 9727 = 49030) with no refunds against them. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.

Cobalt's net of 33952 matches orders 112 and 115 (6135 + 34468 = 40603) minus refund 115 (6651). All three balances check out against the orders and refunds, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net balance of 49030 was already checked against orders 111 and 114, so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net balance of 33952 matches orders 112 and 115 minus refund 115, and the refunds table matched Alpha's report, so I'll record the last payout for cobalt.

All three payouts were recorded successfully after checking the refunds table against Alpha's report and reconciling each net balance against the orders and refunds. Nothing remains, so I'm finishing with the report.
